```{r installing and calling Rpackages}
install.packages("Rsampling")
install.packages("vegan")
install.packages("pbapply")
install.packages("ggplot2")
install.packages("glmmTMB")
install.packages("DHARMa")
install.packages("dplyr")
install.packages("tidyr")
install.packages("emmeans")
```

```{r calling Rpackages}
library(Rsampling)
library(vegan)
library(pbapply)
library(ggplot2)
library(glmmTMB)
library(DHARMa)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(emmeans)
```

```{r importing the data}
data_raw <- read.table("~/Jussara_autotomy/data/raw/data.tsv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = T, sep='\t')
```

Information that we discussed in the reunion: 
We need to make a descriptive analyses (glmm) comparing if the autotomy differ between: population (which is the collectors because they collected only 1 time each year in four different years ps: the data is temporally organized - 2002, 2009, 2011, 2012); type of leg (1,2,3 or 4); and side (right or left)

```{r transforming into a long table}
df_long <- data_raw[, -c(10, 11, 12)] %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = r1:l4,
               names_to = "leg_id",
               values_to = "autotomy") %>%
  mutate(
    side = ifelse(grepl("^r", leg_id), "right", "left"),
    leg = gsub("[rl]", "", leg_id)
  )
```

```{r resuming the data - not necessary, just checking some infos}
df_long %>% filter(population == "MC", autotomy == 0) %>% nrow() #3538
df_long %>% filter(population == "MC", autotomy == 1) %>% nrow() #342
(3538+342)/8 # 485 (n de indivíduos em MC)
342/3880 # 0.088

# data_raw = 1141 
1141*8 # = 9128 (df_long)

```

Please check the following tests, I feel like I did something wrong, but I don't know what.

```{r models for the glmm}

m0 <- glmmTMB(autotomy ~ 1 + (1|id), family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = df_long)

mZI <- glmmTMB(autotomy ~ 1 + (1|id), family = binomial(link = "logit"), ziformula = ~1, data = df_long)


m1 <- glmmTMB(autotomy ~ side * leg * population + (1|id), family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = df_long)

m2 <- glmmTMB(autotomy ~ side + leg + population + (1|id), family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = df_long)


m3 <- glmmTMB(autotomy ~ side + leg + (1|id), family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = df_long)

m4 <- glmmTMB(autotomy ~ leg + population + (1|id), family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = df_long)

m5 <- glmmTMB(autotomy ~ side + population + (1|id), family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = df_long)


aic <- AIC(m0, mZI, m1, m2, m3, m4, m5)
aic[order(aic$AIC),]
aic$delta <- aic$AIC - min(aic$AIC)

# m2 is the lowest AIC but m4 had a difference of only dAIC = 0.27
# consistent with the result that the population and type of leg are significant, but the side don't matter
summary(m2)
```

```{r cheking the residuals using the DHARMa package}
res <- simulateResiduals(m2, plot = T)
testZeroInflation(res)
testDispersion(res)
testUniformity(res)
```

```{r anova - teste de razão de verossimilhança}

anova(m0, m1, test = "Chisq") # interaction < 2.2e-16 ***
anova(m0, m2, test = "Chisq") # no interaction < 2.2e-16 ***

anova(m3, m2, test = "Chisq") # population 0.0003033 ***
anova(m4, m2, test = "Chisq") # side 0.1322
anova(m5, m2, test = "Chisq") # leg < 2.2e-16 ***

```

```{r Post-Hoc ? Using emmeans}

emmeans(m2, pairwise ~ leg, type = "response")
emmeans(m2, pairwise ~ population, type = "response")

```
